title: 第九章 小先生第十章 数学和八股一点都不搭
lines: 满心不高兴的朱莹，这一顿晚饭却吃完了。原因和中午单纯是饿了还不一样，因为她只尝了一口就觉得，带着乡间野趣的饭菜相当美味。当然，张寿那绝佳的手艺，绝不能浪费！
而晚上睡觉前洗脸洗脚时，朱大小姐不好意思让吴氏再帮忙，可小心了再小心，结果前襟还是沾湿了大半，好在晚上原本就要换洗，她只能换了一套吴氏临时找出来，没上过身的中衣和亵裤，虽说短了一大截，可临时凑合，她却也顾不得料子粗糙了。
接下来这一觉，偶尔出门必定择床的她竟是做了个美梦！
梦中，张寿不再对她若即若离，而是笑得温文尔雅，最终，她几乎是笑醒的！
当再一次睁开眼睛时，她甚至听到了自己的笑声。等好容易清醒了一些，她才立刻咳嗽一声，习惯性地叫了一声湛金，发现没听到反应，她不由睁开眼睛茫然四顾，足足好一会方才意识到自己不是在家里，而本来睡在外头的吴氏早就不在了。
朱莹慌忙坐起身，见床边便是衣架，上头搭着一套男子衣衫，不禁眼睛一亮，连忙下了床趿拉了鞋子过去试穿。
总算张寿这一套行头倒也简便，她刚穿好，对着铜镜端详里头那位朴素中透着华美的小郎君，外间就传来了吴氏的敲门声，却原来是人在外头听到动静，来送热水以及早餐。
在吴氏的帮忙下梳洗之后，看了一眼那简单却干净的清粥小菜以及两个小巧玲珑的白面馒头，朱莹瞥见天光大亮的外头，顾不得吃便开口问道：“吴姨，什么时辰了？”
“快辰初（九点）了。”吴氏见这位千金大小姐倒吸一口凉气，已经因为这一天一夜的相处，对人了解了几分的她便笑道，“这是乡下，又不是赵国公府，晚起一会儿不妨事的。阿寿早起出门还特意嘱咐过，说是让你多睡一会儿。”
朱莹没注意其他，只听到了两个字，出门！
想到昨天在厨房和晚饭时都被张寿“嫌弃”了，如今他竟然撇下她不顾，她不由得更加憋屈。她朱大小姐勾勾手，京城无数贵介子弟趋之若鹜，他竟然还跑！她还没拿他怎么样呢！
赌气似的哼了一声，她方才强挤出一丝笑容：“到底是我不该起那么晚……对了，阿寿他上哪去了？”
这么多年过去，吴氏对这桩婚事早已不存多大希望，尤其是昨天被朱公权羞辱过后。可朱莹挟持张寿离开了那么久又回来之后，突然性子大改，起意留下，又分明对张寿很好奇的样子，她心里既觉得欢喜，却也有一种说不出的骄傲。
便是生长在乡间又如何？那也掩盖不了我家阿寿的光芒！
她当即笑吟吟地说：“阿寿在家里闲不住，这会儿大概是在给村里那些少年郎讲课。”
朱莹不禁暗自吃惊。她按捺住了追根问底的冲动，点点头后就飞快地吃完了这顿已经晚了的早餐，随即问了吴氏张寿在哪讲课，最终，不识路途的她到底还是带了张家仆人阿六。
张家大宅位于村口，昨天朱莹只到了这里，便已经觉得简朴到简陋，今天深入村中，她方才算是真正领略了，诗词歌赋中描绘得无限美好的田园乡居生活，现实中是个什么光景。
沿路所见的房舍年岁不一，大多数年久失修，屋顶瓦片残破，甚至还有四面漏风，只用竹篱和茅草搭起来的简易窝棚，散发着阵阵恶臭。
当然，她完全不知道，最后那些窝棚是猪圈。
路上，她好不容易从阿六口中掏出几句话，原来，张家所在的这个村子，因从前张家收租很轻，更不曾盘剥乡里，已经算是京畿地面上，温饱能够相对得到保证的“富村”之一。
如今是水稻收割季，村中壮年男女很少，大多数农人都去忙着下地干活了，就连稍大一点的孩子也不例外。自家没有稻田的，自然是去帮别家收割水稻，来日自家麦地或是棉田收获的时候，曾经得过帮助的再把工时还回来，这也是张寿三年来提倡的制度之一。
当然，朱莹并不知道这一点，只觉得路上能看到的，大多是那些三四岁满地乱跑的幼童。
联想到昨天张寿那谁知盘中餐，粒粒皆辛苦，朱莹此时对这诗句不禁有了更深的体会。
content_en:
Zhu Ying, who was full of dissatisfaction, had finished her dinner. The reason was different from simply being hungry at noon, because after just one bite, she felt that the food with a rustic flavor was quite delicious. Of course, Zhang Shou's excellent craftsmanship must not be wasted!
When she was washing her face and feet before going to bed at night, Miss Zhu was too embarrassed to ask Wu to help, but as careful as she was, most of her front was still wet. Fortunately, she had to change her clothes at night, so she could only change into a set of clothes that Wu had found temporarily. Although they were quite short, she could improvise, but she couldn't care less about the rough materials.
During the next sleep, she, who always chose a bed when going out, had a sweet dream!
In the dream, Zhang Shou no longer treated her indifferently, but smiled gently and gracefully. In the end, she almost woke up with a smile!
When she opened her eyes again, she even heard her own laughter. After she finally woke up, she immediately coughed and called Zhan Jin out of habit. When she found that she didn't hear a response, she couldn't help but open her eyes and look around blankly. It took a long time before she realized that she was not at home, and Wu who was sleeping outside was long gone.
Zhu Ying hurriedly sat up and saw a clothes rack next to the bed with a set of men's clothes on it. Her eyes lit up and she quickly got out of bed, pulled her shoes and tried them on.
After all, Zhang Shou's outfit was simple. She had just put it on and looked at the simple but gorgeous young gentleman inside in the bronze mirror. There was a knock on Wu's door from outside. It turned out that someone heard the noise outside and came to bring hot water and breakfast.
After washing up with Wu's help, Zhu Ying took a look at the simple but clean porridge and side dishes and two small and exquisite white-faced steamed buns. Zhu Ying caught a glimpse of the bright light outside and asked without caring about eating: "Aunt Wu, what time is it?"
"It's almost nine o'clock in the morning." Mrs. Wu took a breath when she saw this rich young lady. She had already gotten to know people a little bit because of the day and night together, and she smiled and said, "This is the countryside, not the Duke of Zhao's mansion. It's okay to get up a little late. Ah Shou got up early and went out and specifically asked you to sleep a little longer."
Zhu Ying didn't pay attention to anything else. She only heard two words, go out!
She couldn't help but feel even more aggrieved when she thought that Zhang Shou had been "disgusted" by Zhang Shou yesterday in the kitchen and at dinner, and now he actually left her alone. She, Miss Zhu, was flirting with her, and countless noble disciples in the capital were flocking to her, but he actually ran away! She hasn't done anything to him yet!
After snorting in anger, she forced a smile: "I shouldn't have gotten up so late... By the way, where has Shou gone?"
After so many years, Wu no longer had much hope for this marriage, especially after being humiliated by Zhu Gongquan yesterday. But after Zhu Ying took Zhang Shou hostage and left for so long and then came back, she suddenly changed her temper and decided to stay, and she was clearly curious about Zhang Shou. She felt happy in her heart, but also felt an indescribable pride.
So what if you grew up in the countryside? That can't cover up the light of my family's Shou!
She immediately said with a smile: "Ah Shou is busy at home. He is probably giving lectures to the young men in the village."
Zhu Ying couldn't help but be secretly surprised. She resisted the urge to get to the bottom of things, nodded and quickly finished her late breakfast, and then asked Wu where Zhang Shou was giving lectures. In the end, not knowing the way around, she took the Zhang family's servant Ah Liu with her.
The Zhang family mansion is located at the entrance of the village. Zhu Ying only arrived here yesterday and already felt it was so simple and crude. Today, when she went deep into the village, she could truly appreciate what the infinitely beautiful pastoral rural life described in poems and songs was like in reality.
The houses seen along the road are of various ages. Most of them are in disrepair, with broken roof tiles and even air leakage from all sides. The simple shacks built with only bamboo fences and thatch emit a stench.
Of course, she had no idea that those shacks at the end were pig pens.
On the way, she finally managed to get a few words out of Ah Liu's mouth. It turned out that the village where the Zhang family was located was considered one of the "rich villages" in the capital, where food and clothing could be relatively guaranteed because the Zhang family used to collect rent very lightly and never exploited the village.
Now is the rice harvest season, and there are very few middle-aged men and women in the village. Most farmers are busy working in the fields, even the older children. Those who don’t have rice fields at home will naturally help others harvest rice. When their own wheat fields or cotton fields are harvested, those who have received help will have their working hours returned. This is also one of the systems Zhang Shou has advocated for the past three years.
Of course, Zhu Ying didn't know this. She just felt that most of the people she saw on the road were three or four-year-old children running around.
Thinking of how Zhang Shouna had worked so hard for the meal yesterday, Zhu Ying could not help but have a deeper understanding of this poem.
title_en: Chapter 9 Little Teacher Chapter 10 Mathematics and stereotypes are not compatible at all
